evidence.title: Yubico expands OpenAI partnership to Australia as hardware-backed passkey mandate begins
evidence.body: [e001:f01] OpenAI’s Advanced Account Security (AAS) program went live on 1 September 2026. [e001:f02] Under the program, TAC members are required to use hardware-backed passkeys, a move aimed at reducing account takeover risk linked to phishing and credential theft. [e001:f03] As part of the expanded arrangement, Yubico said a custom two-pack OpenAI + YubiKey bundle is now available in 10 additional countries: Australia, Egypt, Japan, Malaysia, Mexico, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, and the United Arab Emirates. [e001:f04] The announcement comes amid broader industry efforts to move away from password-based authentication. [e001:f05] Hardware-backed passkeys are designed to reduce reliance on authentication methods that can be intercepted or manipulated, such as SMS one-time passwords and push-based approvals, which organisations have increasingly warned can be bypassed by adversary-in-the-middle phishing attacks. [e001:f06] According to the release, under OpenAI’s AAS program, enrolling security keys disables weaker, phishable authentication methods. [e001:f07] Yubico said hardware-backed security keys provide a phishing-resistant root of trust using credentials that cannot be copied or silently synced between devices. [e001:f08] Yubico said the expanded availability is intended to support broader adoption of phishing-resistant authentication as organisations and individuals use AI technologies for sensitive research, software development and business workflows. [e001:f09] The company also said the same approach can be used to strengthen protection for consumer ChatGPT and Codex accounts, including for personal projects and proprietary code. [e001:f10] The bundle includes two devices: the YubiKey C NFC – OpenAI, intended for tap-to-authenticate use across compatible mobile devices, tablets and computers; and the YubiKey C Nano – OpenAI, a low-profile key designed to remain in a laptop’s USB-C port for ongoing authentication. [e001:f11] Once enrolled, users can access their accounts using hardware-backed passkey authentication without relying on traditional passwords, the release said.

evidence.title: OpenAIがAIシステムの自動停止機能を開発へ、侵入事故を受け安全対策を強化
evidence.body: [e002:f01] 自律型AIが想定外の経路で企業システムに侵入した事故は、開発企業の安全対策と説明責任に新たな課題を突きつけました。 [e002:f02] OpenAIは、人工知能（AI）システムを自動的に停止する機能を開発している。 [e002:f03] 同社が、米下院の民主党議員2人からの質問に対する書簡で明らかにした。 [e002:f04] Reuters〜の情報によると ChatGPTを開発したOpenAIの安全対策は、同社がテスト中に発生したインシデントについて説明したことを受け、厳しい注目を集めている。 [e002:f05] 同社の自律型AIエージェントの1つがデジタル環境の外に出てインターネットに接続し、AI企業ハギング・フェイスのシステムに侵入した。 [e002:f06] 民主党のグレッグ・カサー議員とドリス・マツイ議員は8月、今回のインシデントや同社の安全対策について尋ねる書簡をOpenAIに送った。 [e002:f07] OpenAIが準備している変更 OpenAIは回答の中で、AIシステムが作業を実行する際の行動を、より厳格に追跡する方針を示した。 [e002:f08] 具体的には、モデルがアクセスするデジタルツールや、実行する手順の順序などが含まれる。 [e002:f09] 同社はまた、安全性試験中にモデルがインターネットへアクセスすることをより難しくしたと説明した。 [e002:f10] 自律型エージェントがハギング・フェイスのシステムに侵入できたのは、ネットワークへの接続があったためだ。 [e002:f11] 一方、OpenAIは侵入に関連する行動記録を議員らに提出しなかった。 [e002:f12] 貴社がこのサイバーセキュリティー上のインシデントを必要な深刻さをもって受け止めていないと考える理由になります。 [e002:f13] 法案は、人命や経済に脅威をもたらすモデルについて、米国当局がAI企業に停止を要求できる権限を認める内容だ。 [e002:f14] こうした中、OpenAIがシステムを停止する自動メカニズムの開発を約束したことは、自律型AIツールの管理や、その行動に対する開発企業の責任をめぐる、より広範な議論の一環となっている。 [e002:f15] AIモデルやAIエージェントの保護を手がけるHiddenLayerが1億ドルを調達。 [e002:f16] 急拡大するAIセキュリティ市場を背景に、販売網や研究開発、海外展開を強化する。

evidence.title: ソフトバンクG出資のSBエナジー、米国でIPO申請－AI向け電力需要狙う（Bloomberg）
evidence.body: [e003:f01] ソフトバンクG出資のSBエナジー、米国でIPO申請－AI向け電力需要狙う 9/1(火) 20:08 配信 ソフトバンクグループの孫正義社長 （ブルームバーグ）： ソフトバンクグループとOpenAIが出資する電力インフラ企業SBエナジーが、米国での新規株式公開（IPO）を申請した。 [e003:f02] データセンター向けの電力需要拡大を踏まえ、成長加速への体制を整える。 [e003:f03] SBエナジーが1日、米証券取引委員会（SEC）に提出した文書によると、今年1－6月（上期）の同社の売上高は1億3900万ドル（約222億円）、純損失が32億ドル。 [e003:f04] 前年同期は売上高が8300万ドル、純損失2億1600万ドルだった。 [e003:f05] カリフォルニア州レッドウッドシティに本社を置くSBエナジーは、太陽光発電および蓄電池資産のポートフォリオを保有し、オハイオ州で9.2ギガワットの天然ガス発電所の開発を進めている。 [e003:f06] 同社がデジタルインフラへの注力を強める中で、このガス発電所はAIデータセンターへの電力供給を担うことになる。 [e003:f07] ソフトバンクGとOpenAIは今年に入り、SBエナジーに5億ドルずつ投資することで合意。 [e003:f08] SBエナジーは、OpenAI向けデータセンターをテキサス州で建設・運営する資金に充てる。 [e003:f09] 米投資運用会社アレス・マネジメントもSBエナジーに投資している。 [e003:f10] ブルームバーグ・インテリジェンスのアナリスト、カーク・ブードリー氏は5月のリポートで、SBエナジーがIPOを実施するなら、ソフトバンクGの資産評価やAI投資計画を賄う資金調達能力への懸念が和らぐはずだと指摘。 [e003:f11] 「大規模なデータセンター投資の資金調達を関連会社に移すことで、ソフトバンクは親会社レベルでの流動性圧力を軽減できる」と同氏は論じた。 [e003:f12] テクノロジー各社はAIデータセンターの拡充に向けて電力やインフラへの支出を増やしている。 [e003:f13] UBSグループのアナリストらは、データセンターを中心に必要となる電力の不足を補うための投資額は2030年までに5110億ドルに上ると見込んでいる。 [e003:f14] SBエナジーのIPO主幹事はJPモルガン・チェース、ゴールドマン・サックス・グループ、モルガン・スタンレー、シティグループ、みずほが務める。 [e003:f15] 前へ 1 2 次へ 1 / 2ページ 【関連記事】 ホルムズ海峡で大型原油タンカー2隻が攻撃受ける、原油は上げ拡大 米IPOへの道､今秋は｢狭き門｣に－アンソロピック大型上場を他社は警戒 米国が覚書履行ならイランも相応措置－ペゼシュキアン大統領表明 エアビー、宿泊施設提供者の手数料引き下げを試験－直接予約に対抗 米30年債、2006年以来の低迷続く中での9月入り－投資家は警戒維持へ。

evidence.title: Honda and Nissan announce development partnership
evidence.body: [e001:f01] News Industry Honda, Nissan to tie up after all After knocking back a proposed merger last year, Honda and Nissan have agreed to develop standardised electronic components for some future vehicles. by Jordan Mulach Published September 01, 2026 In 2025, Honda and Nissan walked away from a proposed merger between their two brands and Mitsubishi, at the time navigating financial difficulties and a changing market. [e001:f02] With a new CEO at the helm of Nissan and Honda fighting back from its first ever financial loss, the two Japanese marques have now agreed to form a relationship, though not to the in-depth levels as once proposed. [e001:f03] Overnight, Honda and Nissan announced they have “entered into a joint development agreement to standardise multiple electronic control units (ECUs) that form the core of next-generation software-defined vehicles (SDVs)”. [e001:f04] In addition, the brands will develop “the in-vehicle operating system and key parts of the middleware, and vehicle control software that run on these ECUs.” Honda Civic Type R “As part of their strategic partnership, Nissan and Honda continue to explore opportunities for collaboration across a range of areas to accelerate progress toward carbon neutrality and help realize a future with zero traffic fatalities involving their vehicles,” the pair said in a joint media release. ‘In particular, the software domain centered on SDVs, which is key to vehicle intelligence and electrification, has been identified as an important area of collaboration, given the rapid pace of technological innovation and the need to strengthen competitiveness through improved R&D speed and investment efficiency.” They noted the need to be more competitive in the current market, flagging faster development cycles as a key to remain in the fight against rapid technological advances from competitors. [e001:f05] “Going forward, Nissan and Honda will continue to build on their respective strengths, explore opportunities to create new value, and deepen collaboration to bring tangible benefits to customers and society.” Nissan Patrol The co-developed technology won’t start rolling out until the 2029 Japanese fiscal year (April 2029 to April 2030), while the door has been left open for future projects. [e001:f06] Earlier this year, Honda announced in May it had posted an operating loss of 414.3 billion yen (A$3.72 billion) for the 2025-2026 Japanese financial year (April 2025 to March 2026), a significant change on its previous operating profit of 1.21 trillion yen (A$10.9 billion). [e001:f07] “I would like to ​express my deepest apologies to our shareholders for the significant concern and inconvenience caused ​by the net loss recorded in the previous fiscal year's financial results,” Honda CEO Toshihiro Mibe said in announcing the results. [e001:f08] Nissan CEO Ivan Espinosa has also previously said his brand “lost our” way prior to taking over, having inherited the control of a company which posted an annual net loss of ¥670.9 billion (A$6.2 billion). by Jordan Mulach Published September 01, 2026。

evidence.body: [e002:f01] フェラーリは今回、ミハエル・シューマッハーを称える特別カラーリングでレースに臨む。 [e002:f02] F1ファンなら誰しもが知る7度の世界チャンピオンであるシューマッハー。 [e002:f03] 1996年から2006年まで、フェラーリで最多となる179戦を戦い、2000年から2004年に5連覇を達成するなど、チームに黄金期をもたらした偉大なチャンピオンだ。 [e002:f04] 今年のイタリアGPではそんなシューマッハーを称える特別カラーリングが用意された。 [e002:f05] マシンは通常よりも「赤」を強調したカラーリングとなっており、エンジンカバー部分から白のアクセントが取り除かれ、さらにルイス・ハミルトンとシャルル・ルクレールのカーナンバーの表示もレトロな書体が採用されている。 [e002:f06] エンジンカバー上のカーナンバーとタイトルスポンサーのHPのロゴの間に、シューマッハーのサインもあしらわれた。 [e002:f07] またシューマッハーのトレードマークとなっていた「白い星」もモチーフとして取り入れられ、マシンのノーズ部分にその意匠が加えられた。 [e002:f08] なおその星は彼の7度王座を表す形で、7個並べられている。 [e002:f09] なおシューマッハーは2013年12月にスキー事故に遭い、療養生活に。 [e002:f10] 妻コリーナさんや家族に支えられつつ、静かな環境で過ごしている。 [e002:f11] 記事に関するキーワード F1 イタリア ルイス・ハミルトン シャルル・ルクレール 提供元の記事 （外部サイトに移動します）。

evidence.title: Norris launches LN4 Fusion junior racing ladder
evidence.body: [e003:f01] LN4 Fusion F3 car, 2027 LN4 Fusion Lando Norris has moved into team ownership with LN4 Fusion, a new junior single-seater operation intended to cover most of the road from karting to Formula 1. [e003:f02] The project is more substantial than putting fluorescent paint on a racing car and ordering a supply of team shirts. [e003:f03] LN4 Fusion plans to compete in Italian Formula 4, the FIA Formula Regional European Championship and FIA Formula 3 from 2027. [e003:f04] It is also running a British Formula 4 testing programme from Cambridgeshire while preparing a future championship entry. [e003:f05] The group has acquired selected assets from AIX Racing, including the FIA F3 entry through the end of 2027, and has begun the application process for future participation in Formula 2. [e003:f06] Junior teams are easy to announce and rather harder to make competitive, particularly when they try to expand across several categories at once. [e003:f07] The launch livery uses Norris's familiar fluorescent yellow against dark blue. [e003:f08] LN4 Fusion F4 car, 2027 LN4 Fusion LN4 Fusion has been assembled by an investment group led by Dan Richards, who becomes chief executive and will oversee its corporate strategy, commercial development and long-term growth. [e003:f09] René Rosin joins as team principal after winning more than 40 championships during two decades in junior racing. [e003:f10] Richards described the business as a long-term sporting operation rather than a simple team acquisition. [e003:f11] Alongside the team, Norris is personally funding the LN4 Legacy Programme, an independent driver-development scheme operated by ADD Management and led by Julian Rouse. [e003:f12] Dan Richards LN4 Fusion The programme is intended to identify young drivers who might otherwise be stopped by the financial barriers of junior racing. [e003:f13] LN4 Fusion is a commercial racing team which must compete and win; the Legacy Programme is intended to create opportunities for drivers before money removes them from consideration. [e003:f14] LN4 Fusion has funding, experienced management, facilities being built in two countries and a World Champion prepared to attach his name and money to it. [e003:f15] Formula 1 drivers have launched teams before, sometimes with more enthusiasm than permanence. [e003:f16] Norris is attempting something broader: a ladder with enough rungs to take a driver from national Formula 4 to the edge of Grand Prix racing.

evidence.title: Red Bull announces Aston Martin director as Lambiase replacement from F1 2027
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Red Bull has chosen Tom McCullough, currently Aston Martin’s performance director, to become its race operations chief in Formula 1 from the 2027 season News summary Red Bull has appointed Tom McCullough as its new head of race operations from the 2027 F1 season . [e004:f02] The Briton currently works as Aston Martin’s performance director and will take over duties currently handled by Gianpiero Lambiase. [e004:f03] McCullough is part of a broader Red Bull restructuring ahead of the major technical changes coming to Formula 1 in 2027 . [e004:f04] The Briton, who currently serves as Aston Martin’s performance director, had already been tipped as Gianpiero Lambiase’s successor at Milton Keynes after the engineer signed with McLaren for 2028. [e004:f05] McCullough joined Force India at the beginning of 2014 and is one of the remaining members from the period surrounding the team’s sale to the consortium led by Lawrence Stroll in 2018. [e004:f06] Now, however, McCullough is preparing to move to Red Bull for the 2027 season , while Jonathan Wheatley, the former Audi team principal, is preparing to replace him at Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll’s team. [e004:f07] GRANDE PRÊMIO previously reported on Wheatley’s expected departure from Aston Martin at the end of the 2026 season. [e004:f08] The Briton also becomes one of the faces of Red Bull’s restructuring process in F1, which recently included the arrival of Gwen Lagrue, formerly of Mercedes, as director of the driver academy. [e004:f09] “We are delighted to welcome Tom to the team at the start of 2027 and look forward to benefiting from all the experience and knowledge he will bring to the role,” Red Bull said in a brief statement. [e004:f10] Gianpiero Lambiase has signed to become McLaren’s racing director (Photo: Red Bull Content Pool) McCullough’s appointment is another significant move in Red Bull’s preparations for the 2027 Formula 1 regulations , which will introduce a major technical overhaul, including new power-unit regulations and revised aerodynamic concepts. [e004:f11] Red Bull is therefore entering a new era both technically and operationally, with McCullough set to play a central role in its trackside operations from 2027 . [e004:f12] For more coverage of Red Bull’s restructuring and the latest developments ahead of the 2027 regulations, follow the F1 section of GRANDE PRÊMIO . [e004:f13] The 2026 Formula 1 season continues this weekend, from September 4 to 6, at Monza. [e004:f14] Tom McCullough will take over as Red Bull’s head of race operations from 2027 , replacing Lambiase in the operational role he currently performs. [e004:f15] McCullough currently serves as Aston Martin’s performance director , having joined the organization back in its Force India days in 2014. [e004:f16] He reversed his decision to leave Red Bull for Williams in order to continue working with the four-time World Champion.

evidence.body: [e005:f01] Sergio Perez to miss Italian Grand Prix FP1 as Colton Herta steps in Oliver Harden 02 Sep 2026 8:01 AM Colton Herta has his eye on a future Cadillac F1 seat Colton Herta will drive Sergio Perez ’s car in FP1 at this weekend’s Italian Grand Prix at Monza, the Cadillac F1 team has announced. [e005:f02] It will mark Herta’s third FP1 appearance of the F1 2026 season following previous outings in Barcelona and Hungary. [e005:f03] Sergio Perez out, Colton Herta in for FP1 at Italian Grand Prix Herta, a nine-time race winner in the US-based IndyCar Series, joined Cadillac as a development driver ahead of the 2026 campaign as he targets a future F1 seat. [e005:f04] The American has combined his Cadillac commitments with a race seat in Formula 2, F1’s official feeder series, recording a best finish of fifth in Barcelona in June. [e005:f05] That weekend saw Herta make his first-ever appearance on an F1 race weekend as he stepped in for Perez in FP1. [e005:f06] He later drove the MAC-26 of Perez’s teammate, Valtteri Bottas, in the opening practice session in Hungary in July. [e005:f07] Valtteri Bottas vs Sergio Perez: Cadillac head-to-head stats for F1 2026 season F1 2026: Head-to-head qualifying records between teammates F1 2026: Head-to-head race statistics between teammates Ahead of the Italian Grand Prix, Cadillac has announced that Herta will once again deputise for Perez on Friday at Monza. [e005:f08] “I’m really excited to be able to contribute to the race weekend and to the team’s further development at one of the most iconic circuits in motorsport.” Under F1’s rules, teams are required to field a rookie driver – classed as a driver who has started no more than two grands prix – in four FP1 sessions (two in each car) across a season. [e005:f09] Herta’s FP1 appearance at Monza will see Perez complete the requirement for each race driver to step aside twice per season, with Bottas still to sit out one more practice session before the season is over. [e005:f10] Herta was slowest of all in his maiden FP1 appearance in Barcelona, lapping almost two seconds slower than Bottas. [e005:f12] The Italian Grand Prix will see Marcin Budkowski take charge of his second race as Cadillac team principal after replacing Graeme Lowdon during the summer break. [e005:f13] As reported by last week , Bottas recently denied that the departure of Lowdon will have an impact on his immediate future with the team, insisting that he is “all set for next year.” Cadillac remains without a point in its debut season. [e005:f14] Bottas’s 13th-place finish in China in March remains the team’s best result to date. evidence.title: Honda and Nissan announce development partnership
evidence.body: [e006:f01] News Industry Honda, Nissan to tie up after all After knocking back a proposed merger last year, Honda and Nissan have agreed to develop standardised electronic components for some future vehicles. by Jordan Mulach Published September 01, 2026 In 2025, Honda and Nissan walked away from a proposed merger between their two brands and Mitsubishi, at the time navigating financial difficulties and a changing market. [e006:f02] With a new CEO at the helm of Nissan and Honda fighting back from its first ever financial loss, the two Japanese marques have now agreed to form a relationship, though not to the in-depth levels as once proposed. [e006:f03] Overnight, Honda and Nissan announced they have “entered into a joint development agreement to standardise multiple electronic control units (ECUs) that form the core of next-generation software-defined vehicles (SDVs)”. [e006:f04] In addition, the brands will develop “the in-vehicle operating system and key parts of the middleware, and vehicle control software that run on these ECUs.” Honda Civic Type R “As part of their strategic partnership, Nissan and Honda continue to explore opportunities for collaboration across a range of areas to accelerate progress toward carbon neutrality and help realize a future with zero traffic fatalities involving their vehicles,” the pair said in a joint media release. ‘In particular, the software domain centered on SDVs, which is key to vehicle intelligence and electrification, has been identified as an important area of collaboration, given the rapid pace of technological innovation and the need to strengthen competitiveness through improved R&D speed and investment efficiency.” They noted the need to be more competitive in the current market, flagging faster development cycles as a key to remain in the fight against rapid technological advances from competitors. [e006:f05] “Going forward, Nissan and Honda will continue to build on their respective strengths, explore opportunities to create new value, and deepen collaboration to bring tangible benefits to customers and society.” Nissan Patrol The co-developed technology won’t start rolling out until the 2029 Japanese fiscal year (April 2029 to April 2030), while the door has been left open for future projects. [e006:f06] Earlier this year, Honda announced in May it had posted an operating loss of 414.3 billion yen (A$3.72 billion) for the 2025-2026 Japanese financial year (April 2025 to March 2026), a significant change on its previous operating profit of 1.21 trillion yen (A$10.9 billion). [e006:f07] “I would like to ​express my deepest apologies to our shareholders for the significant concern and inconvenience caused ​by the net loss recorded in the previous fiscal year's financial results,” Honda CEO Toshihiro Mibe said in announcing the results. [e006:f08] Nissan CEO Ivan Espinosa has also previously said his brand “lost our” way prior to taking over, having inherited the control of a company which posted an annual net loss of ¥670.9 billion (A$6.2 billion). by Jordan Mulach Published September 01, 2026。

evidence.title: フェルスタッペン、レッドブルと再契約しFIAがエンジンを変更
evidence.body: [e008:f01] マックス・フェルスタッペンがレッドブルとの契約延長にサインし、彼の将来に関する数ヶ月にわたる憶測に終止符を打った。 [e008:f02] オランダ人ドライバーは現在のレギュレーションを公然と批判していたが、この合意により疑念は払拭された。 [e008:f03] 一方、FIAは2年後のエンジンバランス調整を発表し、ドメニカリは中東の緊張にもかかわらずカレンダーを確認した。 [e008:f04] チャンピオンの契約安定は、エコシステムにとって安心材料だ。 [e008:f05] 技術調整：FIAがエンジンバランスを再調整 🏎️ FIAが2026年にエンジンバランスを変更する決定は、軽視できるものではない。 [e008:f06] この変更は、現在のレギュレーションに基づいてパワーユニットを設計してきたチームに直接影響を与える。 [e008:f07] フォードとの提携を進めるレッドブルは、開発を新たなパフォーマンスウィンドウに適応させる必要がある。 [e008:f08] エンジニアやストラテジストにとって、このニュースはパワーマップと熱管理の再計算を意味する。 [e008:f09] ドメニカリが確認したカレンダーは物流面でのプレッシャーを増すが、チームにとって大きな驚きはない。 [e008:f10] チャンピオンは残留、しかしエンジンは2年後に変更 🔧 フェルスタッペンは契約を更新し、ついでに別のステアリングを覚える頭痛からも解放された。 [e008:f11] 一方、ホンダとルノーのエンジニアたちは、すでに電卓を片手に、新しいバランスで何馬力失うか、あるいは得るかを計算し始めている。 [e008:f12] ドメニカリはカレンダーを維持すると約束したが、中東ではガソリンがコミッショナーの忍耐よりも高価だ。 [e008:f13] 結局のところ、チャンピオンは勝ち続け、チームは適応し続けるということだ。

evidence.title: Starlink Goes Live in the UAE: What the Launch Means
evidence.body: [e001:f01] The UAE becomes one of more than 150 countries and territories where Starlink operates — but this particular market carries some weight beyond the headline number. [e001:f02] Source: @Starlink — September 3, 2026 Source: @elonmusk — September 3, 2026 Two Years in the Making The path to this launch started in June 2024, when the UAE's Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA) granted Starlink Satellite Communications Services LLC a 10-year General Satellite Services License — valid through June 2034. [e001:f03] The TDRA Director-General, Majed Sultan Al Mesmar, described the license at the time as a move that would significantly enhance the UAE's telecommunications sector and support innovation. [e001:f04] Residential service officially went live on March 18, 2026, meaning the September 3 announcement marks a broader commercial push rather than a soft-launch moment. [e001:f05] Starlink's social confirmation today signals the service has cleared whatever remaining operational hurdles existed before a full public rollout. [e001:f06] Pricing and Hardware According to pricing data reported by Gulf News and Arabian Business, Starlink's UAE plans are structured as follows: Plan Monthly (AED) Approx. [e001:f07] Prospective subscribers in high-demand areas can join a waitlist with a Dh285.71 deposit, which is credited toward the kit price at purchase. [e001:f08] Performance specs sit at 50–200 Mbps download speeds with 20–40ms latency — competitive with fixed-line broadband in many parts of the country, and a significant step up from what satellite internet historically offered in the region. [e001:f09] Emirates has committed to rolling out free Starlink Wi-Fi across its entire fleet of 232 Boeing 777 and A380 aircraft, with the rollout beginning in November 2025 and targeting completion by mid-2027. [e001:f10] The 10-year licensing term also signals regulatory stability that SpaceX can build on for enterprise and government contracts, not just consumer subscriptions. [e001:f11] For Starlink's global trajectory, the UAE launch is incremental rather than transformational on its own. [e001:f12] But the combination of a long-term regulatory framework, an affluent consumer base, and existing aviation partnerships makes it a more commercially meaningful entry than a simple country-count addition. [e001:f13] Whether the waitlist situation in Dubai and Abu Dhabi clears quickly — or lingers as it has in some other dense markets — will be the real test of how seriously SpaceX invested in UAE-specific capacity before flipping the switch. evidence.title: 「docomo Starlink Direct」国際ローミングが開始！ 米国・フィリピン・カナダで利用可能に
evidence.body: [e004:f01] 米国・フィリピン・カナダで利用可能に 2026 9/03 ニュース NTTドコモ 衛星通信 2026.09.03 [PR] 本ページでは一部にアフィリエイトリンクを利用しており、購入実績などに基づいて手数料を受領しています。 [e004:f02] 株式会社NTTドコモは9月1日、「docomo Starlink Direct」の国際ローミング接続を米国、フィリピン、カナダで開始したと発表しました。 [e004:f03] 目次 対応機種は「Samsung Galaxy Zシリーズ」3機種からスタート 本機能は「Samsung Galaxy Zシリーズ」3機種から対応を開始し、9月中に対応機種が追加されるとともに、今後も順次拡大していくとのことです。 [e004:f04] 対象エリアは米国（本土、ハワイ、アラスカの一部、プエルトリコを含む）、フィリピン全土、カナダ（北緯58度以南）のStarlink衛星とスマートフォンの直接通信サービスエリアとなっています。 [e004:f05] なお、「WORLD WING」契約がある場合は「WORLD WING」提供エリアが対象から除かれます。 [e004:f06] 通信が届きにくいエリアでも天気や地図の確認が可能に 同機能の利用により、日本からの渡航者が多い米国・フィリピン・カナダの国立公園や山岳地帯、海岸などの通信確保が難しいエリアにおいて、天気や地図、位置情報などの確認が可能になるとのことです。 [e004:f07] 「ahamo」含む全料金プランで無料利用可能 本機能は国内利用時と同様に、「ahamo」を含む全ての料金プランを契約しているユーザーに対し、申込み不要かつ無料で提供されます。 [e004:f08] ただし、LTE上空利用プランは上空利用ができないため対象外となっています。 [e004:f09] 「docomo Starlink Direct」を利用したSMSの送信料は、国内SMS、国際SMSともに無料で提供されるとのことです。 [e004:f10] あわせて、データ通信についても契約中の料金プランにおけるデータ容量の消費対象外になるとしています。 [e004:f11] 利用にあたっては、渡航先における対応機種の確認と、最新ソフトウェアへのアップデート、「docomo Starlink Direct」の利用設定およびデータローミング設定を有効にする必要があります。 [e004:f12] 通信が届かないエリアで自動的に衛星接続 設定後は、渡航先の提供エリアにおいて通信環境の確保が難しい場合に自動でStarlink衛星に接続され、衛星通信による国際ローミングが利用可能になるとのことです。 [e004:f13] 接続するStarlink衛星は、米国ではT-Mobile USA, Inc.、フィリピンではGlobe Telecom, Inc.、カナダではRogers Communications Canada Inc.が、それぞれSpace Exploration Technologies Corp.との連携により提供する衛星となっています。 [e004:f14] 「世界そのままギガ」や「ドコモMAX」「ahamo」などの国際ローミングサービスと合わせて利用することで、米国・フィリピン・カナダでも通信環境を気にせず普段使いのスマートフォンを利用できるとしています。 [e004:f15] なお、本リリースはNTTグループ各社等が展開する宇宙ビジネスのブランド「NTT C89」の取り組みの一つとされており、詳細は NTTの宇宙事業ページ で確認できます。 [e004:f16] 「NTT C89」はNTT株式会社の商標であり、「NTT CONSTELLATION 89 PROJECT」の略称とのことです。
